items.text: Schwab's compensation package (described for its Advisor Services segment) rewards both employee and company performance and includes performance-based incentive pay and equity awards in addition to base pay.
items.quote: Schwab offers a compensation package that rewards both employee and company performance. The package encompasses an array of compensation components in addition to base pay including performance-based incentive pay, equity awards, recognition awards, and a range of health and wellness benefits.

items.text: Schwab uses adjusted diluted EPS and return on tangible common equity as components of performance criteria for employee bonus and certain executive management incentive compensation arrangements.
items.quote: The Company also uses adjusted diluted EPS and return on tangible common equity as components of performance criteria for employee bonus and certain executive management incentive compensation arrangements. The Compensation Committee of CSC's Board of Directors maintains discretion in evaluating performance against these criteria.

items.text: Schwab's 2022 Stock Incentive Plan provides for granting stock options and restricted stock units to employees and non-employee directors.
items.quote: Schwab's 2022 Stock Incentive Plan provides for granting options and restricted stock units to employees and non-employee directors.

items.text: Schwab has a Corporate Executive Bonus Plan, as amended and restated effective January 1, 2026.
items.quote: The Charles Schwab Corporation Corporate Executive Bonus Plan, as amended and restated effective January 1, 2026, filed as Exhibit 10.435 to the Registrant's Form 10-K for the year ended December 31, 2025, and incorporated herein by reference.

items.text: If a capital buffer falls below the minimum requirement, Schwab and Charles Schwab Bank would be subject to increasingly strict limits on discretionary bonus payments to executive officers.
items.quote: If a buffer falls below the minimum requirement, CSC and CSB would be subject to increasingly strict limits on capital distributions and discretionary bonus payments to executive officers.

items.text: Senior management created the Incentive Compensation Risk Oversight Committee to provide oversight of incentive compensation risks, reporting directly to the Compensation Committee of the Board of Directors.
items.quote: Senior management created the Incentive Compensation Risk Oversight Committee to provide oversight of incentive compensation risks and achieve sound incentive compensation risk management practices; it reports directly to the Compensation Committee of the Board of Directors.

items.text: Certain Forge equity awards assumed upon acquisition, with performance-based restricted stock units converted into restricted stock units without performance conditions.
items.quote: Certain Forge equity awards, whether vested or unvested, were assumed by the Company upon acquisition. The awards are subject to the same terms and conditions that were applicable immediately before the acquisition, except for performance-based restricted stock units which were converted into restricted stock units without performance conditions.
